info.title: Greip - Fraud Prevention Universal API
info.description: Greip - Fraud Prevention provides IP intelligence, validation, and fraud-scoring APIs for geolocation, reputation checks, email and phone verification, domain and BIN/IBAN lookup, and payment risk analysis.

delete.description: Deletes stored user data from Greip.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.
